acceptance: the changes are committed as atomic logical commits, one concern each, never mixing unrelated concerns in one commit
each commit carries a conventional prefix (feat/fix/refactor/chore/docs/test) and a message naming at most 2-3 actions
foundational changes come before their consumers and every commit builds — no commit references something a later commit introduces
any doc or skill the repo's CLAUDE.md ties to a changed area was updated in the same set of commits before the split
